knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Unused product is kept in its labelled container or disposed of as the SDS and local rules direct, never poured into drains or garden beds.
A bulged hose can fail under pressure, so it is isolated, replaced or removed from service, and recorded.
High pressure can remove paint that is already thin or damaged.

practicalCriteria: Stores a set of sample products in original labelled containers, apart from food and from incompatible products, with the SDS located for each.
Inspects a pressure washer and its hoses and couplings, and identifies a simulated defect that requires isolation.
Chooses a pressure and distance for a simulated area of weakened paint, and records the choice.
passRule: Storage correct, defect isolated and recorded, and pressure choice recorded, observed by an assessor. A quiz pass is not a practical pass.
evidenceRequired: Pressure equipment check record with the simulated defect and action
stopWorkCriteria: High pressure applied to weakened paint or to a person
Product poured into a drain or garden bed
